component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.clock = CreateObject("roTimespan") m.grid = m.top.findNode("grid") root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for i = 0 to 15 root.createChild("ContentNode").title = "Item " + i.toStr() end for m.grid.content = root for each f in ["itemFocused", "itemUnfocused", "itemSelected", "scrollingStatus", "currFocusColumn", "currFocusRow"] m.grid.observeField(f, "onField") end for m.grid.setFocus(true) print "PROBE|" + m.clock.TotalMilliseconds().toStr() + "|ready" print "PROBE|0|MANUAL|press" end sub
sub onField(event as object) value = event.getData() if type(value) = "roFloat" or type(value) = "Float" then value = Int(value * 100) / 100 print "PROBE|" + m.clock.TotalMilliseconds().toStr() + "|" + event.getField() + "=" + value.toStr() end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean print "PROBE|" + m.clock.TotalMilliseconds().toStr() + "|key " + key + " " + press.toStr() return false end function
